title: Inflation eased. Fuel did not.
gapNote: Seconds held after each voice line ends, before the next shot cuts.
orderNote: The film is not the page in order. The page runs column to split, one claim per section. The film runs five beats: a premise card states the claim in type before any chart, the baseline and the fracture show what the data is, the price level says what it meant, the fuel says what it leads to, and the leads card names the so-what before the sign-off. The state spread and the urban split stay on the page. A minute is not long enough for six claims and two cards, so the film keeps the four that carry the argument and the leads card carries the two numbers to plan with.
